groups.rationale: Base.Object constructs _object_ as per-instance event storage: listener arrays and getHandlers/fireEvent closures. Derived objects inherit this storage through constructor calls. These exact reflected descendants describe SDK implementation state, not separate Flutter operations or event payload contracts. Public on/off/addListener methods are NOT excluded. Every inventory row remains preserved; no exclusion applies to new IDs, public documentation or changed evidence.

The exact Circle _shape_status object is allocated by the pinned constructor. Its isVisible member is state read/written by the native setVisible and rendering/event code, not a separate operation required on the Flutter object. Only these two representation rows are adjudicated; setVisible, visible input options, redraw, errors, event filtering and lifecycle contracts remain independently OPEN. This does not certify behavior or exclude other descendants.
groups.scopeLimit: Representation scope only; public methods, options, lifecycle and platform behavior remain independent.
